cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 66% of energy names green

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Nuclear & Uranium lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +1.57%; weakest is Nuclear & Uranium at -0.79%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: SEDG is the standout at +6.38%
cards.body: Leaders: SEDG +6.38%, BE +5.63%, NXT +5.08%, WFRD +2.83%, VRT +2.80%. Laggards: LNG -2.20%, BWXT -2.19%, NRG -1.53%, CEG -1.26%.
